This model is not open-source and is designed to provide large-scale thinking capabilities for various applications. The architecture of Arcee AI: Trinity Large Thinking is not explicitly stated, but its capabilities and benchmarks suggest a robust and versatile model. With a context window of 262,144 tokens and a maximum output of 262,144 tokens, this model can handle extensive and complex inputs and outputs.

This model is best suited for applications such as chat, text generation, coding, analysis, RAG pipelines, and summarization.
